stem:
Lokesh presses a crushed groundnut on paper. A lasting oily patch shows when he holds the paper against the light.

What does the oily patch show?

options.text: Fat is present only because the patch looks dark, without needing an oily mark against light.
Fat is absent because the paper shows no blue-black colour.

teacher.key_rationale: A lasting oily patch visible against light shows fat. Naming starch instead, judging from darkness alone, or using the starch blue-black test to deny fat all miss that fat-test hinge.
